nodes.name: Trigger
nodes.notes: Agent tool (two-step cancel, owner decision 2026-10-08): contact_id (from WF-1, never the model) and appt_id (from find_client's upcoming). It records a pending cancellation and answers whether it would be late; it never cancels. WF-1 replaces the agent's text with the CANCEL_PENDING / LATE_CANCEL_PENDING question built from the row, and the client's YES makes WF-1 run cancel_booking (internal). cancel_booking is not an agent tool any more.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData: an empty Settings table reaches Decide, which fails the tool (-> WF-6) instead of ending the run silently.

nodes.name: Appointment
nodes.notes: appt_id goes into the formula only if it is a plain appt_id (^A-[0-9A-Z-]{1,40}$); anything else searches for a row that cannot exist, and Decide answers NOT_FOUND.

nodes.name: Mark Requested
nodes.notes: Only cancel_expires_at is written: the status, the calendar event and the client stay as they are until the client's YES. A new request for the same visit moves the expiry; WF-1 writes cancel_asked_at when the question has gone out.
